basic_details.job_title: MbPA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 Radiology Technician Apprentice and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA), Medical Department, has 7 apprenticeship seats for the year 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act, 1961: 3 for Medico Laboratory Technician Apprentice and 4 for Radiology Technician Apprentice, each with 12 months of training and a stipend of Rs.10,900/- or Rs.12,300/- per month. Applications are offline only, and the filled form must reach the Establishment section, Medical Department, Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai – 400037 by hand or by post on or before 18 December 2026, up to 5:00 pm.

important_instructions: After selection, the candidate must enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship in the prescribed form under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and final selection is subject to registration of the contract with the BOAT (WR). An apprentice who abandons the training before completion will be liable to pay the cost of training (maximum for an amount of three month's stipend) or an amount decided by the BOAT (WR); legal action will be initiated if this is not paid. MbPA has no obligation to offer employment to apprentices during or after the apprenticeship, and apprentices cannot claim employment in MbPA on completing the apprenticeship. Apprentices must observe all conduct rules applicable to workmen in the Port Authority; any dispute arising out of the contract will be referred to the BOAT (WR). Candidature will be cancelled if the candidate fails to produce the required original documents for verification or if any discrepancy is noticed; a candidate found ineligible at any stage will be summarily dismissed without notice. No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance will be paid to candidates called for document verification and Medical Examination. MbPA administration does not undertake to send a reply or call to candidates not selected, and its decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and mode of selection is final. content_sections.heading: About MbPA
content_sections.text: Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) is the port authority in Mumbai, and this apprenticeship notice is issued by its Medical Department. Applications are handled by the Establishment section of the Medical Department at the Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai. The notice states that all apprentices will be given practical training at the respective faculties of MbPA.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: Mumbai Port Authority has notified 7 apprenticeship seats in two trades for 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following minimum qualification for each trade. Where CGPA, OGPA or a letter grade is awarded in the minimum qualification examination, the applicant must give the equivalent aggregate percentage of marks in the application form, as per the norms adopted by the Institute or Board, and must submit a copy of those norms. For the full trade-wise eligibility, candidates should check the official notification. To undergo apprenticeship training, the minimum age limit is 18 years and there is no upper age limit. The application form asks for the applicant's age on 01/11/2026. Applicants who have already undergone, or are undergoing, apprenticeship training in the same trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any organisation are not eligible to apply. After selection, the candidate must give a declaration that he or she has not undergone apprenticeship training anywhere under the Apprentices Act. Reservation will be as per the prevailing practice in MbPA. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the seats. Candidates who want the benefit of SC, ST or OBC reservation must produce the original Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format stipulated by the Government of India. Reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for those with not less than 40% of the relevant disability certified by a Medical Board appointed by the Central or State Government. Applicants in the Physical Handicap category must produce the original Physical Handicap Certificate issued by the competent medical board. If the copy of the certificate is not attached, the application will be considered in the General Category and eligibility will be decided as per the General Category.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Both trades have a training period of 12 months. The monthly stipend depends on the type of apprentice: Each apprentice is allowed two kinds of leave during the training period: Casual Leave of 12 days and Medical Leave of 15 days. Practical training will be given at the respective faculties of MbPA.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the MbPA apprenticeship is through a merit list, followed by verification of original documents and the selection procedure, and a physical fitness test for selected candidates. The merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of total marks obtained in the respective faculty. Preference will be given to candidates with a higher qualification in addition to the minimum educational qualification, in descending order: Post Graduate, Graduate, 3 Years Diploma. If two candidates have secured the same marks, the elder candidate will be placed above in the merit list. Preference will be given to wards of MbPA employees, and separate merit lists will be prepared for wards of MbPA employees and other candidates. The merit list(s) will be displayed on the notice board at the office of the Establishment section, Medical Department, Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai – 400037 and uploaded on www.mumbaiport.gov.in . Candidates in the merit list will be called for verification of all original documents and the selection procedure at the same Establishment section; the reporting date will be displayed on the notice board and uploaded on the website. A candidate on the merit list who is not present and duly prepared on the reporting date will be rejected, the next candidate on the panel merit list will be considered, and no representation will be entertained. All selected candidates will undergo a physical fitness test at the MbPA Hospital, Wadala.

faq.question: Q1. How many seats are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 seats: 3 for Medico Laboratory Technician Apprentice and 4 for Radiology Technician Apprentice for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MbPA apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The application form must reach the Establishment section, Medical Department, Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai – 400037 on or before 18 December 2026, up to 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: Medico Laboratory Technician Apprentice needs a Diploma (SSC+3 years or HSC + 2 Years) OR Degree (3 Years) in Laboratory Technology, and Radiology Technician Apprentice needs a Diploma (SSC+3 years or HSC + 2 Years) OR Degree (3 Years) in Radiology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MbPA apprentices?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and there is no upper age limit; the application form asks for the age on 01/11/2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much stipend will MbPA apprentices get?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.10,900/- per month for Technician Apprentices, Diploma holders and sandwich course students, and Rs.12,300/- per month for Graduate or Degree Apprentices, for 12 months of training.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/-, accepted only by NEFT to The Board of Mumbai Port Authority (SBI A/c No. 10996685430, IFSC SBIN0000300), with the UTR receipt attached to the form. SC, ST and physically handicapped candidates do not pay the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the MbPA apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed offline form completely, attach the UTR receipt and attested documents, and submit it by hand delivery or by post to the Establishment section, Medical Department, Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai – 400037.

faq.question: Q8. How will MbPA apprentices be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a merit list based on the percentage of total marks in the respective faculty, with preference to higher qualification and to wards of MbPA employees, followed by document verification and a physical fitness test at the MbPA Hospital, Wadala.

faq.question: Q9. Can someone who has already done an apprenticeship apply?
faq.answer: No. Applicants who have already undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training in the same trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any organisation are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Is the MbPA apprenticeship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. MbPA has no obligation to offer employment during or after the apprenticeship, and apprentices cannot claim employment in MbPA on completing it.
